_comment_: 128 x 128 x 64 cells at dx=dy=10 m, dz=1 m (1280 x 1280 x 64 m), stored whole; the training dataset takes one random 64 x 64 x 32 window per volume (crop_windows.py; z offset 1-31 so the engine's floor and roof, where the level ladder is anchored, never coincide with a window edge). Design: channel depth 3-16 m log-uniform; nlevel from a sampled aggradation ratio (level spacing / depth, U(0.7, 1.4)) so the column is spanned floor to roof; per-level event budget scaled by the plan area; n_sources {1,1,2,3}; probAvulOutside sampled; entry scatter stdevCHsource log-uniform 5-300 m; correlated porosity texture inside sand; entries on the grid boundary and the walk clipped by the grid.

grid._comment_dx_: 128 x 128 x 64 cells at dx=dy=10 m, dz=1 m (1280 x 1280 x 64 m), stored whole; the training dataset takes one random 64 x 64 x 32 window per volume (z offset 1-31 so the engine's floor and roof, where the level ladder is anchored, never coincide with a window edge). dx=dy=10m, dz=1m. OXBOW channels are ~55m wide -> 5-6 cells (W:D=11, depth=5m). Migration step ~3m -> 0.3 cells/event (very tight bends). 8 levels x 5m channel depth fills the 50m basin nicely.

preset._comment_: Specialised preset: single highly sinuous channel per level, neck-cutoff oxbow loops painted as FFCH mud plugs. Keeps stdevCHsource=1 (single channel) and probAvul*=0 (no avulsion).

mCHsinu._comment_: VARIED. Mean sinuosity. Preset baseline 1.5; high sinuosity is the whole signature, range covers tight to highly tortuous.

mCHwdratio._comment_: VARIED. OXBOW W:D. Narrow meander belt.

mCHdepth._comment_: VARIED. Channel depth (m), log-uniform so 3-8 m stays as common as 8-16 m; 16 m = half the column, two levels at least.

mdistMigrate._comment_: VARIED. Migration distance per event (m). Preset baseline 3. Tight migration -> tight bends -> neck cutoffs.

mNeckFFCHprop._comment_: VARIED. Fraction of upper channel column painted as FFCH mud plug at neck-cutoff. Preset baseline 0.5 — distinctive feature of OXBOW preset.

azimuth._comment_: VARIED. Flow direction (deg, clockwise from +x). Channels are not 180-symmetric so the full circle matters.

probAvulInside._comment_: FIXED at preset baseline. Must stay 0 to keep single-channel-per-level. Varying breaks the OXBOW signature.

probAvulOutside._comment_: VARIED (preset default 0.0). Probability per event that a fresh river enters from the boundary; times ntime this is the number of fresh entries per level, spread over the n_sources valleys.

mFFCHprop._comment_: FIXED at preset baseline. Mud plugs are handled by mNeckFFCHprop instead.

stdevCHsource._comment_: VARIED. Across-flow scatter (std, m) of the entry point of every channel drawn from the pool; 1 m fixed would be a nodal entry. 5 m keeps that, 300 m spreads entries over the whole 1280 m edge.

mCSnum._comment_: splays disabled — adds visual complexity without diagnostic value; future versions can re-enable.

nlevel._comment_: AUTO. Aggradation ratio r = level spacing / channel depth, uniform 0.7-1.4 per reservoir; nlevel = round((64 - depth) / (r * depth)) + 1 so the levels span the whole 64 m column: r < 1 stacked channels cut into each other, r > 1 floodplain between levels, never more than 0.4 depth.

level_z._comment_: skip — class default. Engine spreads 8 levels evenly across nz*dz=50m.

ntime._comment_: 150 events per level: the preset's budget for an 800 x 800 m box x2.56 (plan area) for 1280 x 1280 m. ntime is a cap: a level stops as soon as it has its NTG share, so only high-NTG rows use the extra events. Measured 2026-09-22: with the old cap SH_DIST delivered 0.73 of target, x1.6 0.82, x2.56 0.88.

ntime_per_level._comment_: TRUE so every level gets its own event budget (independent of how many lower levels consumed). Without this, deep levels starve when NTGtarget=0.99 stops never firing.

stdevCHsinu._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.15 -> 0.03 (tight sinuosity distribution).

stdevCHdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.4 -> 0.3.

stdevCHwdratio._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 0.5.

stdevdistMigrate._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 10 -> 0.6 (tight migration distribution).

mLVdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 0.8.

stdevLVdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.2 -> 0.1.

stdevLVheight._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.1 -> 0.05.

mLVasym._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.3 -> 0.0 (symmetric levees).

mLVthin._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.3 -> 0.0.

Cf._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.0078 -> 0.0036.

scour_factor._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 2.0 -> 10.0.

Q._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 5.0 -> 3.256 (matches Pyrcz tutorial Showcase B hydraulics).

n_sources._comment_: VARIED. Entry points on the upstream edge; sources at least 15% of the edge apart.

poro_noise_std._comment_: VARIED. Relative std of a correlated porosity texture inside sand cells; perm follows via the K-C slope. 0 = smooth ramp.

poro_noise_range._comment_: VARIED. Lateral correlation length of that texture in cells (20-80 m); vertical is a third.

_comment_shard_size_: 32: the writer buffers a whole shard in memory and a 128 x 128 x 64 sample is 6 MB, so 1000 samples would be 6 GB per rank and 144 ranks would need 860 GB on a 237 GB node. 32 samples = 192 MB per rank.
